Test centrality empirical

Source: R/centrality.R
test_centrality_emp.Rd

Tests using empirical method

Usage

test_centrality_emp(
  g,
  centrality = ".degree",
  preds = NULL,
  n_sims = 999,
  min_alpha = 0.01
)

Arguments

g

An igraph object.

centrality

Name of the centrality measure to plot. Either a vertex attribute of g (e.g. ".degree") or one of the computed measures: "closeness", "betweenness" or "eigen_centrality".

preds

preds to test

n_sims

number of sims

min_alpha

min alpha

Value

table indicating any significant predictors

Examples

test_centrality_emp(example_network, ".degree", "genetic_sex")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   predictor   centrality KW_pv dunn            
#>   <chr>       <chr>      <dbl> <list>          
#> 1 genetic_sex .degree    0.982 <tibble [1 × 4]>
